ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity dominant; estimated <5% high-intensity (white) pixels vs >95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. High-contrast white point clusters are localized at the distal tips and in sparse circular formations within the central-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal vertex angle of 115 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the maximum visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration map along the entire posterior boundary. Peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 4 to 15 pixels, with the highest frequency of variations observed on the left lobe (viewer perspective).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, following a non-linear curve with increasing positive slope towards the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 6 distinct, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) on the left lobe, and 2 smaller clusters on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible thin linear pixel disruption, approx. 18 pixels in length, oriented vertically on the lower-left lobe section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-contrast, irregular textured growths (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips of both lobes, with higher pixel volume on the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse distribution of micro-pixel (1-2px) high-intensity white points across the dark pigmentation field, likely light reflection from water droplets or small parasitic attachments.
